subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first Control UI product slice, or require a fuller calendar design before implementation continues?
rationale: The request adds new Control UI product surface, and the open linked PR covers only part of the requested daily/week calendar, stats, drag/drop editing, and validation behavior.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Use the linked PR or a fresh branch to add a current-UI 24-hour timeline while tracking broader calendar features separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop, and validator behavior as one cohesive feature.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close this feature and the linked implementation if maintainers decide the current list/run-history UI is sufficient for core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a fresh branch to add a current-UI 24-hour timeline while tracking broader calendar features separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main cron page creation and older Cron UI history make this the strongest routing signal for the product-scope decision.
